messages:
ops-oncall: FYI 5xx spike on hosted inference API starting ~1712004200. Mostly 502/504 and a bunch of auth timeouts. Error rate up ~6% for the last 8m. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/hosted/api/errors :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy finished: commit abc1234 / rollout-seed=20% @1712004191 by @alice-prod :white_check_mark:
alice-prod: rolling 20% seed earlier for hotpatch to auth proxy config (auth_cache_ttl=30s -> 0s). I pushed a toggle via config-service. Could be related.
bob-infra: seeing lots of upstream TLS handshake timeouts to auth-service-2: `handshake timeout after 10s` in proxy logs. Sample: 
```
2026-03-17T14:12:05Z proxy-1 ERROR upstream handshake timeout auth-service-2:443 path=/v1/token
```

jane-support: getting escalations from 3 customers about generation timeouts and billing hits due to retries. One customer saw 502s on 10k requests. Need communication plan. :exclamation:
sam-sre: Can we repro locally? I ran a curl against hosted endpoint and got 502 consistently when `Authorization` header present: `curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood/v1/generate` returned 502 with body `gateway_error`.
elena-eng: added logs from the staging auth proxy showing a regression after config flip: auth cache disabled caused a thundering of token introspection calls, auth-service instances maxed out and started dropping connections.
ops-oncall: action list: 1) rollback the config toggle to restore cache 2) scale auth-service pool as mitigant 3) pause rollout. Who can flip rollback now?
alice-prod: I'm on it. initiating config rollback to auth_cache_ttl=30s on config-service now. `POST /api/configs/rollback {key: auth_proxy.cache_ttl}`
bob-infra: scaling auth-service by +4 replicas as hotfix. K8s command: `kubectl scale deploy auth-service --replicas=12 -n prod`
sam-sre: pausing rollout: `deploy-bot pause rollout rollout-seed=20% commit=abc1234` -> done.
ops-oncall: rolling back and scaling started. I'll watch errors. ETA 3m.
deploy-bot: config rollback applied at 1712004415 by alice-prod.
elena-eng: logs show auth introspect calls dropping to normal within ~60s. Errors dropping in dashboards.
jane-support: notified impacted customers with status page note + we offered to credit extra retries in billing for the window.
ops-oncall: current error rate down to 0.8% (was 6%). Still seeing occasional 502s for long-running requests. Follow-up: add circuit-breaker on auth-timeouts and add hovewer a soft key for prewarm on rollout.
alice-prod: filing a follow-up ticket for a safer rollout: add migration that ramps cache_ttl gradually and a canary limit to introspect qps. Ticket: SRE-8472.
sam-sre: recommend adding runbook step: if auth cache set to 0, automatically limit request rate to introspection endpoint. Also add alert for introspect 5xx > 1%/5m.
bob-infra: postmortem claim: mis-scoped config flip (global vs seed-scope) caused wider-than-intended change. Will add validation on config-service.
ops-oncall: closing loop here. If error creeps back, @channel escalate to pager and we'll open incident bridge. Thanks all :thumbsup:
